toolbar.exampleLoaded: Example graph loaded — press Ctrl+Z to undo

node.dropOrPaste: Drop or paste file, or click to upload
node.changeIcon: Click to change icon, right-click to remove

panel.aiGenerateSubtitle: Describe your data structure and AI will create the diagram
panel.enterOrUpload: Please enter or upload graph JSON
panel.importNotRecognized: Failed to import: the JSON format was not recognized. Please check that it contains a valid "nodes" array.
panel.legacyFormatRejected: This JSON uses a retired format ({name, fields} nodes or a top-level "groups" key), which is no longer supported. Re-copy the prompt (AI Collaborate → step 1) and have your AI regenerate the diagram, or use the in-app AI Generate.
panel.jsonlHint: Each line creates a separate node. Nodes are arranged in a 3-column grid.
panel.jsonlEmpty: Please enter at least one JSON object
panel.dataMustBeObject: Data must be a JSON object
panel.inputRequired: At least one input field is required
panel.outputRequired: At least one output field with expression is required

paste.nothingAdded: Nothing new to add — everything in that output is already on the canvas
paste.truncated: That output is incomplete — it looks like it was cut off. Go back to the chat and ask it to output the complete JSON again, or continue the answer and paste both parts together.
paste.noJson: No diagram JSON or edit commands found in what you pasted. Copy the prompt again (AI Collaborate → step 1), run it in your AI chat, and paste the answer back.
paste.malformed: Found something that looks like JSON, but it could not be read. Ask the chat to output the JSON again on its own, with nothing before or after it.
paste.notAGraph: That JSON is valid but contains nothing to import. It needs a "nodes" array — or, to only add connections between nodes already on the canvas, a "pipes" array.
paste.continueFromLine: Go back to the chat and ask it to continue from line {{line}} — paste the continuation straight back here.
paste.dslUnreadable: Those look like edit commands, but none of them could be read. Check the first reported line in your chat, or re-copy the prompt (Export -> Copy as Prompt) and ask again.
paste.graphForEditingCopied: Current diagram copied ({{n}} nodes) — paste it into your chat, then ask for the change
paste.graphForEditingTrimmed: Current diagram copied ({{n}} nodes) — example values were left out to keep it short

setOp.union: Union (A ∪ B) — all fields from both
setOp.difference: Difference (A − B) — fields in A not in B
setOp.complement: Complement (B − A) — fields in B not in A

aiCollab.step1Desc: Send it to any AI chat — it teaches the model to answer in diagram commands
